title: Visit each value
summary: Bash: Visit each value. Add 4 to the list.
introduction: A for loop repeats its body for each word in a list. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: Use a terminal with Bash. Save each example as lesson.sh and run bash lesson.sh. These practice scripts do not delete or change files.

blocks.title: Visit each value
blocks.code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
for n in 1 2 3; do
 printf '%s\n' "$n"
done

blocks.text: The for list has three words. Each pass prints its current word.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use "$@" or quoted array expansion when looping over values with spaces.
